title: 8 Men's DII Lacrosse Games To Watch on FloCollege This Weekend - NewsBreak
text:
By Leanza Pieroni ,
1 hours ago 8 Men's DII Lacrosse Games To Watch on FloCollege This Weekend Lacrosse fans — get ready. The stakes ramp up this weekend as eight must-see Division II matchups take center stage on FloCollege, and every single game features at least one ranked opponent.
With the midseason churn in full swing and NCAA Tournament positioning beginning to take shape, these contests could define the early narrative of the 2026 campaign. Rankings below are based on the latest USILA Coaches Poll / USA Lacrosse Top 20 release.
Here are 8 Men’s DII Lacrosse Games To Watch on FloCollege This Weekend:
No. 2 Tampa vs No. 5 Anderson Saturday, March 7 - 12 PM ET
Two DII lacrosse powerhouses collide in what might be Saturday’s biggest battle. Tampa — undefeated and holding the No. 2 spot — hosts an Anderson squad that’s climbed into the Top 5. This clash of southern lax elites promises fireworks as both teams jockey for regional supremacy and national title relevance.
No. 17 Newberry vs No. 6 Lenoir-Rhyne Saturday, March 7 - 4 PM ET
Expect a gritty, physical battle as No. 6 Lenoir-Rhyne takes on No. 17 Newberry. Lenoir-Rhyne has consistently been near the national elite all season, and Newberry looks to prove itself as a giant-killer in this key South Atlantic Conference showdown.
No. 3 Saint Anselm vs No. 12 Molloy Saturday, March 7 - 12 PM ET
In a true cross-country tilt, Saint Anselm hosts Molloy in a marquee matchup of ranked squads. Saint Anselm has national title aspirations, while Molloy brings dynamic offensive firepower and will look to pull off a statement road win.
No. 9 Wingate vs Tusculum Saturday, March 7 - 12 PM ET
Wingate — ranked in the Top 10 and known for its speed and depth — opens conference play against Tusculum. The Bulldogs will test Wingate’s resolve and provide fans with an exciting intra-conference duel.
No. 10 Bentley vs St. Thomas Aquinas Saturday, March 7 - 12 PM ET
A clash in the Northeast pits No. 10 Bentley against a tough St. Thomas Aquinas squad. Bentley’s disciplined style and balanced attack will be challenged by a Saints team eager to prove it belongs among the best.
No. 16 Catawba vs Lincoln Memorial Saturday, March 7 - 1 PM ET
Catawba looks to build on its momentum as it takes on Lincoln Memorial. Ranked teams like Catawba have to defend their national standing early — and this matchup could be a turning point for both programs.
Caldwell vs No. 13 Mercy Saturday, March 7 - 2 PM ET
The Mercy Mavericks enter this game as the ranked side on the road at Caldwell. Mercy’s potent offense will face a tough Caldwell defense in what may be a strategic chess match between Northeast foes.
No. 1 Adelphi vs No. 4 Seton Hill Sunday, March 8 - 12 PM ET
Save the best for last. This Top-5 showdown pits No. 1 Adelphi — the defending champions and early-season favorite — against No. 4 Seton Hill. With major NCAA implications early in the season, this battle of titans could very well foreshadow postseason seeding and national title hopes.
How to Watch Men's Lacrosse On FloCollege All eight games are streaming live on FloCollege this weekend, with kickoff times starting late morning through early afternoon, perfect for lacrosse fans tuning in all day long.
